use base64::{Engine,engine::{Simd,general_purpose::{STANDARD,URL_SAFE,GeneralPurposeConfig}}};
fn main(){
 let simd=Simd::standard(GeneralPurposeConfig::new());let url=Simd::url_safe(GeneralPurposeConfig::new());
 let mut checksum=0u64;
 for length in 0..200usize{
  let input:Vec<u8>=(0..length).map(|i|(i*97+length)as u8).collect();
  let encoded=simd.encode(&input);assert_eq!(encoded,STANDARD.encode(&input));assert_eq!(simd.decode(&encoded).unwrap(),input);
  let encoded_url=url.encode(&input);assert_eq!(encoded_url,URL_SAFE.encode(&input));assert_eq!(url.decode(&encoded_url).unwrap(),input);
  for byte in encoded.bytes(){checksum=checksum.wrapping_mul(31).wrapping_add(byte as u64);}
 }
 assert!(simd.decode("bad~").is_err());println!("{}",checksum);
}
